notes: The place is always a person or an animal (p. 74).
With the pronoun e it becomes cu ne (Nota, p. 75).
den is for a closed or limited space; for an institution or place in general use na: E ta traha na Departamento di Enseñansa (Nota, p. 76).
For origin and a starting time, for di can replace di (Notas 1 and 2, p. 77). Forms ordinals: e di dos (p. 78).
Not entre ... pa: write entre tres or y nueb'or, not entre 10 pa 3 or (Nota, p. 78).
Not riba where di is meant: un estudio di e malesanan, not riba (Nota, p. 81).

en: until; up to; as far as
notes: te cu is often used wrongly where te is meant: di januari te maart (Nota, p. 82).
Named a compound preposition in Notas 1 and 2 on p. 77, where it can replace di.

en: in the name of; on behalf of
